subject: physics
content:
A screw gauge has 50 divisions on its circular scale. The circular scale is 4 units ahead of the
pitch scale marking, prior to use. Upon one complete rotation of the circular scale, a displacement of 0.5mm is noticed on the pitch scale. The nature of zero error involved and the least
count of the screw gauge, are respectively :

options.content: Positive, 0.1 <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.489ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.364ex" height="1.489ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -442 603 658" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D707" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D707"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>m

Least count of screw gauge

=

= 1 10-5 m

= 10 m
